image_description: A vintage cream-colored typewriter sits on a wooden surface. The keyboard features round, black keys with white lettering in a non-standard QWERTY layout. Instead of a traditional elongated space bar key integrated into the bottom row, there is a small, rectangular metal plate labeled 'SPACE BAR' centered below the main key block. In the foreground, loose paper cutouts of letters spell out 'I RUN C A RIO'.
